entries.name: EraVerifierPlonk
entries.description: Verifies a zk-SNARK proof using an implementation of the PlonK proof system.

verificationKeyHash.description: keccak256 hash of the verification keys.

entries.name: NativeBridgeGateway
entries.description: Bridges ETH of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault to the exchange on GRVT and returns failed ETH deposits to the vault. Only the vault can bridge through it.

entries.name: GenericSwapStrategy
entries.description: Yield strategy of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault for one vault token. Whitelisted operators swap registered receipt tokens (e.g. tokenized treasuries) with the strategy at the price of their price sources, within per-swap and per-token exposure caps. Only the vault can allocate to and withdraw from it.

receiptTokens.description: Tokens that the strategy can hold in exchange for the vault token.

priceSources.description: Whitelisted price sources that can price receipt tokens.

entries.name: AaveV3Strategy
entries.description: Yield strategy of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault that supplies the vault token to Aave V3. Only the vault can allocate to and withdraw from it.

entries.name: ValidatorTimelock
entries.description: Intermediary contract between the *Validators* and the central diamond contract that delays block execution (ie withdrawals and other L2 --> L1 messages) by at least 3h. Duration could be configured individually for zk stack chains by chain admins. All delays are capped at 30 days.

executionDelay.description: Ecosystem-wide minimum execution delay (in seconds), set by the owner. The delay enforced for a chain is the maximum of this value and the chain-specific delay.

executionDelay_fmt.description: Ecosystem-wide minimum execution delay, set by the owner. The delay enforced for a chain is the maximum of this value and the chain-specific delay.

entries.name: YieldRecipientTreasury
entries.description: Receives the yield harvested from the strategies of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault and reimburses the vault for strategy entry and exit fees. The owner and authorized withdrawers can send its balance to the withdrawalRecipient.

authorizedVaults.description: Vaults that can pull fee reimbursements from the treasury.

entries.name: TimelockController
entries.description: A timelock with access control. The current minimum delay is 2d.

Executor.description: Executing proposals is only open to all addresses if this resolves to the 0x0 address

entries.name: CompartmentRegistry
entries.description: Registry of compartments: contracts on Ethereum that hold the capital of GRVT vaults withdrawn from L2, deploy it into external yield venues and bridge it back to the vaults on GRVT. The registry also holds the roles and the global pause for all compartments.

compartments.description: All compartments created by the registry.

globallyPaused.description: Stops the creation of compartments and deposits of all compartments into their yield venues. Withdrawals from venues and bridging back to GRVT stay available.

entries.name: GrvtZkEvmAdmin
entries.description: A governance proxy that lets eth:0x3a23919d4aA39e096E9d6420fd6a2861A20B19e5 act through it.

upgradeTimestamps.description: Timestamps for new protocol version upgrades can be registered here (NOT enforced)

entries.name: AaveV3StrategyV2
entries.description: Yield strategy of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault that supplies the vault token to Aave V3. Only the vault can allocate to and withdraw from it.

entries.name: Bootstrap
entries.description: Placeholder implementation that new compartment proxies are deployed with, so that their CREATE2 address does not depend on the real implementation. The CompartmentRegistry upgrades a compartment to its real implementation in the same transaction.

entries.name: UpgradeAuthority
entries.description: Owns the ProxyAdmins of the CompartmentRegistry and of every compartment. Accounts with the REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE in the CompartmentRegistry can use it to upgrade these contracts without delay.

entries.name: EraVerifierFflonk
entries.description: Verifies a zk-SNARK proof using an implementation of the fflonk proof system.

verificationKeyHash.description: keccak256 hash of the verification keys.

entries.name: SGHOStrategy
entries.description: Yield strategy of the GRVTL1TreasuryVault that converts the vault token to GHO through the Aave GHO Stability Module and deposits it into sGHO. Only the vault can allocate to and withdraw from it.

entries.name: ValidiumL1DAValidator
entries.description: Contract that 'verifies' the data availability for validiums. This implementation only checks the correct formatting and does not serve as a DA oracle. Can be used by ZK stack validiums as the L1 part of a DAValidator pair.

entries.name: Governance
entries.description: Allows scheduling transparent and shadow proposals, 'securityCouncil' role can execute without delay.

entries.name: GRVTL1TreasuryVault
entries.description: Holds most of the exchange reserves of GRVT on Ethereum, which the exchange withdraws from GRVT to this vault. The funds can be allocated to whitelisted yield strategies, bridged back to the exchange on GRVT, and yield above the allocated principal is harvested to the yieldRecipient. Strategies and their allocation caps are whitelisted by the VAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

strategiesUSDT.description: Strategies that hold USDT of the vault, including withdraw-only strategies that cannot receive new allocations.

strategiesUSDC.description: Strategies that hold USDC of the vault, including withdraw-only strategies that cannot receive new allocations.

getSupportedVaultTokens.description: Tokens that the vault can allocate to strategies. A new token needs its own strategies field in this template.

l2ExchangeRecipient.description: Exchange contract on GRVT that receives the funds bridged from the vault.

yieldRecipient.description: Receives the yield harvested from strategies. Only the yieldRecipientTimelockController can change it.

paused.description: Stops allocations to strategies, yield harvests and bridging to GRVT. Withdrawals from strategies stay available.

entries.name: TimelockController
entries.description: A timelock with access control. The current minimum delay is 3d.

Executor.description: Executing proposals is only open to all addresses if this resolves to the 0x0 address

entries.name: EraDualVerifier
entries.description: A router contract for verifiers. Routes verification requests to eth:0x8470d6B3fd71B5fE3906B4ea04498d18F721eDe9 or eth:0x0DAAB2B7b38ab48712996E760152c569FA356DbF depending on the supplied proof type.

verificationKeyHash.description: Verification key hash for the PLONK verifier ONLY (backwards compatibility).

entries.name: HighYieldEarnVaultCompartment
entries.description: Compartment of a GRVT vault. It holds vault capital withdrawn from GRVT and deploys it into listed Axcess loan vaults, Nest vaults and Wildcat V2 markets. Proceeds of venue exits always return to the compartment, and funds can only leave it to a listed venue or to the vault's deposit proxy on GRVT through the GRVTBridgeProxy. Venues are listed by the REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE of the CompartmentRegistry.

axcessVaultList.description: Axcess loan vaults (institutional credit) that the compartment can deposit into.

nestVaultList.description: Nest vaults (tokenized real-world assets) that the compartment can deposit into.

wildcatMarketList.description: Wildcat V2 markets (undercollateralized loans) that the compartment can deposit into.

paused.description: Stops deposits into yield venues. Withdrawals from venues and bridging back to GRVT stay available.

entries.name: GRVTBridgeProxy
entries.description: Checks the signature of the DepositApprover for each user deposit and, on succeeding, forwards the user's funds and bridging request to the L1SharedBridge contract to deposit to GRVT. Compartments registered in the compartmentRegistry can deposit without a signature, but only to the L2 deposit proxy derived from their registered vault ID.

compartmentRegistry.description: Every compartment registered in this registry can deposit its tokens to GRVT without a DepositApprover signature. The zero address disables compartment deposits.

vaultDepositProxyBeacon.description: Beacon of the vault deposit proxies on GRVT, used to derive the L2 destination of compartment deposits.

entries.name: Diamond
entries.description: The main contract defining the Layer 2. Operator actions like commiting blocks, providing ZK proofs and executing batches ultimately target this contract which then processes transactions. During batch execution it processes L1 --> L2 and L2 --> L1 transactions.

getSettlementLayer.description: Settlement layer for this chain: the zero address while batches are committed, proven and executed on Ethereum, otherwise the Gateway diamond that settles this chain. Moving it relocates the complete proof-verification and message path of the chain.

getTransactionFilterer.description: This contract must expose the ITransactionFilterer interface (see Mailbox facet) and is used for censoring transactions pushed from L1 to L2.

IsPorterAvailableStatus.description: zkPorter is a volition-like contruction and changes the zk proof input requirements.

isPermanentRollup.description: true means that the DA mode cannot be changed to Validium in the future. compliant DAValidator pairs for the permanent rollup mode are defined/enforced by the RollupDAManager contract.

priorityModeCanBeActivated.description: 1 once the chain admin permanently allowed Priority Mode (ZKsync OS permanent rollups only). Then anyone can activate it as soon as the first unprocessed priority transaction is older than 4 days, after which only the shared PermissionlessValidator can settle batches (anyone can submit through it) and only the ChainTypeManager owner can deactivate it.

priorityModeInfo.description: Raw Priority Mode storage: last byte canBeActivated, byte before it activated, then the PermissionlessValidator address.

priorityModeTransactionFilterer.description: TransactionFilterer that replaces the chain's own filterer once Priority Mode is allowed. Set by the ChainTypeManager owner, zero means no filtering.

getDAValidatorPair.description: l1da, l2da (before v31) or l1da, L2 DA commitment scheme (from v31).

getProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version, increments with each protocol upgrade.

getVerifierParams.description: Verifier parameters used for proving batches.

arg.1: . isPermanentRollup was set to true in this contract which prevents changing the DA mode to Validium in the future.
